Solitaire free, no download, no signup — the NoCharge card shelf

A guide to Klondike and FreeCell rules and controls, with a current V2 note about local score storage.

By NoCharge Editorial·Reviewed by NoCharge Editorial·Published August 27, 2026·Updated November 24, 2026·2 min read
Check the current platform.

Use the public pages behind this explanation.

Open the ArcadeReview PrivacyKeyboard-only play notes

Bottom line: The current NoCharge card shelf has two games: Klondike and FreeCell. Both run in the browser without an account or download; neither saves a win count, best-move total, or game history in V2.

What is available

GameCurrent layoutWhat to plan
KlondikeSeven tableau columns, stock and waste, four foundationsBuild alternating-color runs downward; foundations build upward by suit. The Draw selector switches between one and three cards.
FreeCellEight face-up columns, four free cells, four foundationsUse empty cells and columns to create legal space for descending runs.

Controls and reset

Both games use labeled buttons for card selection and destinations; drag-and-drop is not required. Klondike includes a native Draw selector. The pages show a move count during play and have a Reset to seeded start control that restores the same deal.

The current interface does not provide the old D/U keyboard shortcuts, an Undo button, an automatic foundation move, or a saved best score. Use Tab and Shift+Tab to move among standard controls and Enter or Space to activate a focused button.

No account or saved record

Game state is kept in the active page session. NoCharge V2 does not save wins, best moves, or a current deal to local storage or a server, and it has no My Arcade score dashboard or Clear Game Data button. Browser storage is used for interface and theme preferences, not card-game progress.

Limits

The pages make no claim that every deal is winnable and publish no solvability percentage. Session length depends on the player and the layout. The Solitaire Comparator is a separate tool; it does not mean additional solitaire games are available in the Arcade.
